# <span id="aanchor382"></span> Volume Editor

## Analysis Editor

Use the Analysis Editor to maintain a meter’s analysis components and properties. If a meter has a source assignment, the Analysis Editor will automatically open when you click the Edit button.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Analysis Editor:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor**.
2.  Select a meter.
3.  Click the **Analysis** radio button.
4.  Adjust the date range as needed.
5.  Double-click a row on the grid.

</div>

### Gas Meters

When the assigned Source Analysis is configured to use splits, the C6+ and C7+ splits are applied and shown in the analysis detail view.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 567;height: 519;" />

When the assigned Source Analysis is configured to use extended characterizations, the related C+ properties are applied and shown in the analysis detail view.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 567;height: 519;" />

### Hydrocarbon Liquid Meters

The analysis window for hydrocarbon liquid meters defaults to Mole%.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 573;height: 484;" />

### Non-Hydrocarbon Liquid Meters

The analysis window for non-hydrocarbon liquid meters defaults to NHC Mass%.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 578;height: 520;" />

### BLM Properties

FLOWCAL calculates and displays Heating Value Uncertainty for meters enabled as BLM properties. (See: [Heating Value Uncertainty Details](../BLM/Heating%20Value%20Uncertainty%20Details.md))

Gas meters include the Full Wellstream Factor field. This represents the fraction of measured wellhead production that is natural gas. (See: [Full Wellstream Factor](../Source%20Analysis/Gas%20Quality%20Source%20Editor/Full%20Wellstream%20Factor.md))
